prompts.portrait-kit: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single customizable portrait paper-doll sprite sheet for the SCHISM dystopian city RPG. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, 4 columns by 3 rows of equal 256px square cells, exact evenly spaced grid, no lines, no labels, no lettering. Each component entirely contained within its own cell. Highly polished painterly graphic novel realism, delicate realistic anatomy, visible brushwork, cinematic soft light, entirely monochrome neutral grayscale so the game can tint the skin/hair independently. NOT pixel art. Row 1: three separate beautiful adult HEAD-AND-NECK cutouts facing directly forward with clean-shaven bald heads: feminine, masculine, and androgynous; fourth cell empty. Face expression resilient, ordinary residents not heroes, eyes detailed, lips neutral. Each head with crown around y=30, chin around y=200, neck at bottom, width about 150px, no clothing or shoulders, no hair, no beard. Row 2: four separate HAIR cutouts for those heads: short cropped, asymmetrically swept, chin-length bob, long side braids; no face or body underneath, open transparent face area; hair crown y=25 and sides leaving the eyes visible around y=120; matching head proportions. Row 3: three separate shoulders-and-chest OUTFIT cutouts, neck and head absent, all centered straight forward, shoulders filling width and chest filling lower cell, neckline around y=25. First: worn civilian dark weathercoat. Second: tailored Canon administration uniform in medium gray, mandarin collar, subtle light piping and modest civic insignia. Third: structured dark Canon security uniform with restrained shoulder plates and badge, plausible police not fantasy armor. Fourth: insulated civilian shroud. All components have transparent alpha around them and are separate, aligned for browser compositing. No drop shadows beyond objects, no background.
